title: K-flat counit normalization of the cone connecting map
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of Noetherian schemes, with the recorded derived categories D(O_Y) and D(O_Z) [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe. Let F=Lf* be the recorded derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], supplied with a strong monoidal structure for the recorded derived tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let E=f* be the actual termwise module tensor-pullback functor [def-pc-module-pullback], assumed additive, and H its induced homotopy-category functor. Write Qh_X for the derived localization and c_X(K):O_X[1]⊗K≅K[1] for the canonical shift-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. There exist e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] and a natural transformation epsilon:Qh_Y⋙F→H⋙Qh_Z such that epsilon is invertible on every homotopy object represented by a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For every morphism p:P→Q between K-flat complexes, set C=mappingCone.triangleh(p), T=Qh_Y.mapTriangle(C), and W=(H⋙Qh_Z).mapTriangle(C). Then epsilon(C.obj3)≫W.mor3 = F(T.mor3)≫a(T.obj1)≫epsilon(C.obj1)[1], where a(K) is the composite F(c_Y(K) inverse), the supplied inverse tensorator at (O_Y[1],K), e tensor identity, and c_Z(F(K)). This asserts the connecting-map equality, not an isomorphism of triangles or distinguishedness.

proof.text: Use the K-flat counit of derived pullback and transport it to the actual tensor-pullback functor using the object and morphism formulas of def-pc-derived-pullback. Its components are invertible on K-flat representatives.

Represent the unit and its translate by the structure-sheaf complex in degree zero and its translate. Their termwise pullback and the supplied monoidal unit map give a shifted-unit isomorphism e, chosen before the cone morphism p.

For K-flat P and Q, their cone is K-flat. Apply the additive termwise mapping-cone comparison to the cone projection. Rewrite the translation as tensor with the shifted unit using the canonical first-variable Koszul comparison and shifted left unitor. Tensorator naturality, associativity and its unit equations give the specified projection formula for the supplied tensorator. The remaining component is the shift of the counit at P. This gives exactly epsilon(C3) followed by W.mor3 equals F(T.mor3), the displayed translated-unit comparison, and the shifted counit at C1.

theorem exists_derivedPullback_kFlat_cone_counit_normalization
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive] :
    ∃ e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      ∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
            (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
              schemeDerivedCategory Z),
        (∀ P : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
          IsIso (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))) ∧
        ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (p : P ⟶ Q),
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) Q →
          let C := CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangleh p
          let T := (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Y).mapTriangle.obj C
          let W := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                schemeDerivedCategory Z)).mapTriangle.obj C
          ε.app C.obj₃ ≫ W.mor₃ =
            (derivedPullback f).map T.mor₃ ≫
              ((derivedPullback f).mapIso (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y T.obj₁).symm ≪≫
                asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                  ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) T.obj₁) ≪≫
                tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
                schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z ((derivedPullback f).obj T.obj₁)).hom ≫
                  (ε.app C.obj₁)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
